text_zh: 引擎索其什一——汝每铸一字，其中十分之几必归虚空。
text_en: The Engine claims its tithe—of every word forged, a portion returns to void.

text_zh:
残余异文：RA-217 · 征收蚀失
归属意志：第 VII 层 · 薄册意志
异常概述：铸字坊内全部圣字钉重量以固定速率递减，持续至完全粉化。蚀失速率与目标收容基准呈正相关，基准越高蚀失越快。收容失败时曾导致第 ██ 铸字坊在 ██ 小时内全部字料归零。
收容残余：引擎压制下表现为部分圣字钉质量微幅衰减。键徒铭刻时偶报告'字符变轻'。
附注：以双倍铅料供给抵消蚀失的实验中，蚀失速率反增 ██%。供料愈多，损耗愈烈，违背基础炼金律。油壶内剩余润滑油呈琥珀色，检测显示未发生化学变化。
——「重者愈重，轻者归尘」
text_en:
Residual Anomaly: RA-217 · The Tithe Decay
Source Will: Layer VII · Will of the Ledger
Anomalous Overview: All sacred slugs within foundries experience mass reduction at fixed rate until complete pulverization. Decay rate correlates positively with containment threshold - higher baselines accelerate deterioration. Pre-containment breach resulted in total material loss across Foundry ██ within ██ hours.
Containment Residue: Under Engine suppression manifests as minor mass degradation in select slugs. Operators occasionally report 'lightening letters' during inscription.
Addendum: Experiments doubling lead supply to counter decay resulted in ██% increased deterioration rate. Greater provision yields swifter loss, violating fundamental alchemical law. Remaining lubricant presents amber coloration with no detectable chemical alteration.
——「The heavy grow heavier, the light return to dust」
